{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
severe_count = (df_dedup['severity'] == 'severe').sum()
total_patients = len(df_dedup)
fraction_severe = severe_count / total_patients

severe_count, total_patients, fraction_severe"}
